parts.subject: blank tag attached to rear trunk handle

sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Full-bleed portrait 4:5 production puzzle painting, warm richly detailed oil/gouache storybook realism with subtle brush texture, coherent anatomy and perspective, no text, numerals, brands, famous places, border or UI. Complete natural scene, not a diagram. This clean plate will receive five small hand-painted animated objects later. Draw natural attachment surfaces but omit only the stated small details. Wide intimate view from slightly above of two beautiful BERRY RED and burgundy leather travel trunks on an antique railway luggage bench, muted brass clasps, folded scarf, plain unlettered timetable board, station wooden wall and sliver of train beyond. Berry-red trunks occupy majority of frame, beige wall complements. One bare handle attachment on front trunk for a small blank hanging luggage tag, one small empty vase on bench end for flower, one empty overhead brass hook for a short tassel, one wrapped paper parcel with cord but no bow, one cup on side shelf with warm tea but no steam. Keep tags, markings and signs completely blank.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production hand-painted game cutout atlas. 1536x1024 RGBA with genuine transparent empty background, no glow, colored haze, grid, labels or UI. Invisible three columns/two rows, exactly five objects in reading order and sixth lower-right empty. Each WHOLE object fits central 280x300 within its 512x512 cell, all sides surrounded by at least 100 transparent pixels. Oil/gouache brush texture, coherent warm natural light from upper-left. Fine clean edges, realistic materials. For berry-red luggage in an old railway station, paint (1) a small blank ivory luggage tag suspended from a short complete closed leather loop, no text; (2) one tiny ivory daisy on long slender stem; (3) a small burgundy and gold tassel with COMPLETE closed suspension loop at top; (4) a tan twine parcel bow lying flat at three-quarter angle with subtle transparent tight contact shadow; (5) delicate narrow semitransparent tea steam ending in pointed bottom tip. Each attachment intact and bounded.
